Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939)
Happening to have an excess of M.S. luggage, I am rather glad to send off an instalment of “the [Chaplet of Pearls](../books.html#69)” instead of packing it up.

It threatens to be longer than the [Dove](../books.html#62), and there is a good deal more still to be written, and probably rewritten.
I believe I omitted to say that it would be the most convenient way to me if you could [pay](../others.html#160) the £235, the balance of my account to my name at [Messrs Hoare](../others.html#169)’s.

Yours very truly

C M Yonge
